notes: UI file selection is separated from the package API; complete VP08 families are validated before deterministic DuckDB attachment.
Access links eight tables and suppresses link errors; the package attaches the containing SQLite database only after complete-family and VP08 validation.
Reads the canonical SQLite _table_metadata translation of the Access Env table Description property and returns Unknown when absent.
Activation persists the normalized SQLite path supplied at attachment rather than decoding an Access linked-table connection string.
Coordinator-scoped temporary views replace persistent Access QueryDef rewrites; project activation restores unfiltered views, deactivates any SU, resets CurrPlotlist, and clears SUPath.

A new coordinator has no shared persistent QueryDefs to compare; startup deterministically restores the configured project and optional persisted SU. Failed SU recovery leaves the project active and unfiltered.
The configured complete VP08 SQLite family is attached and activated; any recovery failure falls back to an explicit Sample database and persists that recovered state.
Detachment removes only the DuckDB attachment and explicitly refuses to detach the active project instead of suppressing deletion errors.

SQLite declares valid foreign keys in table schemas and save-as preserves them transactionally. The stale Env.StartDate to Metadata.StartDate declaration is omitted: the Windows Access oracle raises DAO 3799 because Env has Date but no StartDate, and the live database has no Env-Metadata relation.
The project branch is a transactional SQLite core-family clone; the SU and hierarchy branches are implemented by vpro_su_save_as and vpro_hierarchy_save_as.
Temporary Access import tables are replaced by direct transactional SQLite copying.
Direct SQLite copying renames the core family and preserves schema, indexes, foreign keys, data, and version metadata.
All eight target-family collisions are rejected before copying rather than checking only the target Env table.
The copied family is the same eight project suffixes identified by the Access predicate.

Exact _SU suffix matching, structural validation, and explicit caller selection replace Access substring scanning and UI prompts; attachment does not activate the SU and shared SQLite attachments are reused.
Reads the same active-project Env/Admin pair as the Access inner-join record source but returns separate base rows to avoid ambiguous duplicate field names and dependence on mutable QueryDefs.
An explicit package API replaces the bound-form save command; named Env/Admin updates and audit rows commit atomically against canonical SQLite base tables.
The package has no focus-driven implicit save; callers explicitly submit validated named changes through one transactional update operation.
Field-level audit generation is part of the same SQLite transaction as the Env/Admin update rather than a separate bound-form BeforeUpdate event.

Preserves audit-strength rules and project/user/plot/table/field before-after evidence while using explicit user identity, UTC timestamps, base tables, and atomic SQLite writes. Restore behavior remains a separate unresolved slice.
Environmental FS882 changes are recorded with logical table suffix _Env; this includes Admin fields edited through the joined USysEnv form, matching the Access form-level mapping.

Explicit _vpro_su_policy metadata and caller-supplied manage_master_su/attach_master_su permission callbacks replace the Access username allow-list, ambiguous master substring test, unused Tag field, and embedded password.
Copies an explicitly marked master transactionally without attaching or mutating it and records source provenance; no password bypass or inferred merge-back path is retained.
Coordinator-scoped temporary views implement the Env-SU-Admin intersection. Validation precedes mutation, diagnostics are returned, and blank or orphan rows are never deleted implicitly.
Detachment explicitly refuses the active SU, removes only lifecycle registration, and preserves a shared SQLite attachment while any project or other SU still uses it.
Temporary Access imports are replaced by direct transactional SQLite copying of the SU table, rows, explicit indexes, and translated metadata.
The copied SU is written under the requested exact _SU name without attachment or activation, while current SU state remains unchanged.

Exact _Hierarchy suffix selection, structural validation, and explicit caller paths replace Access substring scanning and UI prompts; shared SQLite attachments are reused and attachment does not activate the hierarchy.
Explicit activation replaces direct registry assignment, persists the normalized SQLite path, and exposes a coordinator-scoped Hierarchy compatibility view over the selected named table.
Detachment explicitly refuses the active hierarchy, removes only lifecycle registration, and preserves a shared SQLite attachment while another resource still uses it.
Temporary Access staging is replaced by direct transactional SQLite copying of the hierarchy table, rows, explicit indexes, and translated metadata.
The copied hierarchy is written under the requested exact _Hierarchy name without attachment or activation, while current hierarchy state remains unchanged.
